description:
ZK & TEE Enabled Enforce Compliance Agent (ZEECA) is a blockchain solution that automates the enforcement of Web2 compliance data into Web3 actions. It securely processes sensitive real-world information and executes corresponding on-chain actions while maintaining data privacy.

### Core Features

	•	Automated Compliance Bridge: Converts Web2 legal decisions and private data into automated blockchain actions
	•	Privacy-First Architecture: Combines zkTLS and TEE technology for secure data handling
	•	Trustless Verification: Validates compliance without exposing sensitive information

### Use Cases

	•	Legal compliance automation
	•	Private voting enforcement
	•	Regulatory compliance
	•	Performance-based crowdfunding execution

ZEECA enables trustless, automated compliance between traditional systems and blockchain networks while preserving data privacy and ensuring reliable enforceme

## 🤖 Agent Capabilities

ZEECA agents can aggregate multiple data points and execute actions based on single or combined criteria. Agents continuously monitor, validate, and execute actions when predefined conditions are met.

## 🔄 Automated Actions Based On:

1. **Single Criterion**
2. **Multiple Criteria**
3. **Aggregated Data**

## Examples of ZEECA Applications

### Legal & Compliance

- 🏛️ Court Order Enforcement
  - Automatic asset distribution based on court decisions
  - Enforcement of settlement distributions


### Voting & Governance

- 🗳️ Voiting Results
  - DAO proposal execution based on offchain voting results
  - Automated dividend distribution based on offchain voting results
  - Community fund allocation enforcement

- 🤝 Corporate Governance
  - Board decision implementation
  - Shareholder resolution enforcement
  - Executive compensation distribution

### Finance & Payments

- 💰 Performance-Based Payments
  - Milestone-based fund release
  - Escrow automation based on delivery confirmation
  - Bounty distribution upon task completion
  - Revenue sharing based on performance metrics

- 🏦 Financial Services
  - Insurance claim processing and payout
  - Dividend distribution automation

and many many others
how_its_made:
## Core Architecture Flow

	1.	Data Discovery & Validation

	• LangChain Web Agents scan and parse Web2 sources (court decisions, voting results)
	• Agents validate data authenticity using predefined criteria
	• Results are securely processed within TEE environment [implementation not finished]

	2.	Proof Generation & Verification

	• Coinbase Agents SDK generates zkTLS proofs for validated data
	• Smart contracts verify these proofs on-chain

	3.	On-Chain Execution

	•	Upon successful proof verification, smart contracts trigger corresponding actions
	•	Actions include fund releases, and token minting

## Technical Integration Details

	•	LangChain Web Agents: Custom-configured for specific data sources and validation rules
	•	Coinbase Agents: Integrated for zkTLS proof generation and blockchain interaction
	•	Phala Network TEE: Ensures secure data processing in isolated environment

## Notable Technical Solutions

	•	Created verifiable bridge between Web2.0 and Web3.0
	•	Implemented automated proof verification system

## Partner Technologies used

	•	Coinbase Agents SDK: Provided robust zkTLS implementation and blockchain integration
	•	Phala Network: Offered secure computation environment crucial for sensitive data
	•	LangChain: Enabled sophisticated Web2 data parsing and validation

This architecture ensures trustless, automated compliance while maintaining data privacy throughout the process.
